Its fine, smooth texture blends seamlessly for a polished, salon-quality finish, making it ideal for sculpting extensions, overlays, and tip blending. Packaged in a convenient 15g jar, this transparent powder is a must-have staple for nail technicians and enthusiasts looking for reliable, professional results.

How to Use:

  1. Prep and shape the natural nail.
  2. Dip acrylic brush into monomer liquid.
  3. Pick up the transparent polymer powder to form a bead.
  4. Apply and sculpt onto the nail before the bead sets.
  5. Allow to air-dry, then file and shape as desired.

name: 6-Piece Gold Nail Art Decoration Set
description:
This 6-Piece Gold Nail Art Decoration Set offers a versatile mix of metallic embellishments to elevate any manicure. Each jar contains a different style — from fine caviar beads and crinkled foil flakes to ornate filigree charms, snowflake sequins, and faux pearls — giving nail technicians and enthusiasts endless options for creating eye-catching 3D nail art. Compact and stackable, the jars are easy to store and transport, making this set a convenient addition to any nail art toolkit.

How to Use

  • Prep and polish your nails with your preferred base coat or color polish.
  • Apply a thin layer of top coat or nail gel glue where you wish to place the decorations.
  • Use a pair of tweezers or a wax picker pen to carefully place the gold charms, foil, or beads onto the nail.
  • Gently press down and cure under a UV/LED lamp (if using gel) or allow to air dry.
  • Seal with a durable top coat to lock in shine and prevent snagging.
